title: Base64url changes the last two digits of the alphabet
summary: The + and / of standard Base64 are written as - and _ respectively in Base64url, and the corresponding values are still 62 and 63.
detail: The first 62 characters are identical in both encodings, and samples containing only these characters often make it impossible to distinguish the variants.
boundary: Whether the equal sign padding is omitted is determined by the peripheral protocol, and the alphabet cannot be identified by the presence or absence of the equal sign.
relevance: When comparing two encoding strings, locate whether the difference comes from the alphabet or the original data.
